lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the brown lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central mass, with approximately 40-60 pixels between primary lines at this resolution.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A minor Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal apex of the fourth stripe from the anterior; no other clear mergers are present in the lateral view.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th and 11th lines at the posterior haunch appear as abbreviated, dashed segments. The 5th line shows a clear mid-torso break or discontinuity.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots are visible on the upper posterior hind limb/flank area, forming a low-density triangular grouping.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate spiral, extending posterolaterally from the frontal bone before curving anteromedially at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.2 times the width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately the terminal 18% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white chevron is visible between the medial canthi of the eyes; dark ventral fringe hair is visible along the lower neck and abdomen; all four distal limbs exhibit a transition to high-contrast yellowish-tan pixels below the knee/hock.
